acceptance_rules.binary_identity: The report must bind the exact native VST2 binary SHA-256 and candidate source commit; ARM32 is separately bound and is not a substitute for native callback testing.
acceptance_rules.callback_proof: The harness must load VSTPluginMain and use AEffect dispatcher/setParameter/processReplacing/getChunk/setChunk callbacks. Direct FactoryRuntime calls are not VST acceptance.
acceptance_rules.startup: A normal parameter edit is accepted only after the selected package's exact expected firmware schedule has completed. HALL's expected schedule is 213/213; other effects have package-specific event counts and must not be forced to 213. Pre-startup stress cases are separately labeled and must prove the deferred edit is applied by the active plugin runtime.
acceptance_rules.registers: VST getParameter or display text is not DSP proof. Candidate evidence must include active program, checkpoint, firmware schedule, initial-state hash, serial route, parameter-application frame, ordered register trace and active register snapshot.
acceptance_rules.audio: Finite stereo output, A/B differences and reference comparisons are measured with fixed gain. No automatic gain normalization or audio-derived shift is permitted.
acceptance_rules.alignment: Default comparison aligns by declared input frame zero after removing only explicitly measured fixed latency. If sample rates differ, polyphase conversion is opt-in and reported. No implicit shift, normalization or clock reinterpretation.
acceptance_rules.state: Chunk save/restore must preserve effect and control values; after restore the callback output and active register state must agree with the restored selection.
acceptance_rules.realtime: Callback allocation counter must remain zero; invalid/non-finite host values and audio must not create non-finite outputs or persistent state.

not_proven_by_existing_harness: DSP register writes unless a register trace is attached

startup_stress_cases.mechanism: setParameter before first processReplacing; verify final queued value is applied after startup
setParameter after READY, render subsequent callback blocks
send values A/B/C before startup and verify final C plus active DSP state
parameter changes across first startup callback blocks
start slot 1, process one short block, select slot 2, require only slot 2 ready
VST mains off/on after edit; verify restored parameter and READY status
run same input/state on a newly created VST instance; compare declared alignment and output
set NaN and +/-Inf through AEffect.setParameter; require finite getter and output
send NaN input through processReplacing; require finite output
effGetChunk/effSetChunk around effect/control changes; then render
verify private package-specific event count and schedule hash before accepting edits; HALL specifically requires 213 events
